title: Data-driven HTML
body: Link JSON, JSONL, CSV, Markdown, text, or globs as build-time data. No runtime content fetch required.

title: Filesystem generation
body: Turn folders like [slug], [page], and [locale] into generated routes while keeping every source page valid HTML.

title: Reusable HTML
body: Compose build-time fragments with template and slot. Scope their CSS and JavaScript without adding a client component runtime.

title: Built-in processing
body: Process HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images, and fonts with statica's native pipeline instead of assembling another toolchain.

title: Site features included
body: Pagination, i18n, RSS, sitemaps, static 404s, and forms are available when the site needs them.

title: Fast builds
body: Incremental watch mode, configurable parallel rendering, build reports, and a single native CLI keep the loop tight.
